title: glTF/GLB inspector (counts, world bounds, extensions, licence fields)
summary: Parses GLB/glTF JSON without a 3D library and reports mesh, material, node and animation counts, world-space bounds, risky required extensions (Draco, meshopt, KTX2) and asset.copyright.
description: Ships fixtures/tiny_cube.glb, a 1.3 KB cube with a one-second animation produced by make_cube_glb(), and the builder itself so other tests can create GLBs. Checked during development against NASA's Apollo Lunar Module GLB (Draco-compressed, WebP textures) and the Khronos Duck sample.
